The issuer shows moderate leverage but solid balance-sheet liquidity (current ratio ≈ 1.87) and positive profitability (net margin ≈ 12% and EBIT margin ≈ 16%), which supports ongoing debt service capacity. With total liabilities at ~58% of total assets and no other major credit stress indicators provided, the risk profile appears consistent with the upper investment-grade range rather than higher-tier ratings.

DECISION: BBB+
